release_notes:
FocusDefend v1.9.5 Release — Ultra-Resilient BFS YouTube Shorts & Distracting Channel Engine:
• Single-Pass BFS Node Scanner: YouTube's dynamic Jetpack Compose views and obfuscated view IDs are now bypassed using a 120-node deep BFS scanner that inspects active reel toolbars, Remix buttons, Sound Pivot icons, and Subscribe headers directly.
• Unconditional 0ms Ejection: Opening any Short reel from carousels, feeds, or links immediately triggers GLOBAL_ACTION_BACK to dismiss the reel player instantly.
• Dedicated 'Block Distracting Channels' Setting: Added independent setting in Student Settings (enabled 24/7 by default) that filters non-educational entertainment/gaming channels while permitting verified lectures (PW, Khan Academy, NCERT, Vedantu, Unacademy, etc.).
• Zero-Popup Xiaomi Immunity: Completely clean of WindowManager overlays. Native Android Toasts and firm haptic cues replace screen-freezing popups.
